prompt: I have monthly retail sales data in retail_sales.csv covering January 2015 through December 2024. Can you run a full time series diagnostic on it and tell me whether it is safe to forecast, what kind of seasonality it has, and whether I need to difference it before fitting a model?
assertions: diagnostics.json contains data_quality.frequency equal to monthly
diagnostics.json contains seasonality.is_seasonal equal to true
diagnostics.json contains trend.has_trend equal to true and trend.direction equal to increasing
diagnostics.json contains forecastability.forecastable equal to true
